item.title: RAITE 2026 - Programming Challenge
description: Pampanga State University - Don Honorio Ventura Campus
The programming challenge consisted of two pair of student from different schools. It used CodeChum platform where the event was conducted.
Failed passing the hard programming problems which included problems that require solving with various graph algorithms such as A*.

Practiced various algorithms with NeetCode a month before the event, but it was extremely lacking since I was busy on building a system for our thesis project. Thus, largely contributing to the failure to gain rank during the event.

item.title: Robotics Program
description: Consisted of robots developed using Arduino EEE Robot Kit. It uses scratch-like programming language to build the robot logic
Was be able to make the robot walk on to a detected black-colored line.
The robot had a lot of logical errors on its pathfinding while it was being developed.
